ASUS Picasso camera CCI transaction serialization
================================================

Picasso uses the Qualcomm camera CCI controller (compatible "qcom,cci")
with a board-specific serialization requirement retained from its legacy
camera driver. The remaining properties follow the Qualcomm CCI interface.

Optional property:
- asus,serialize-i2c: Boolean. Serialize I2C core requests with a mutex
  shared by both masters of this controller. Synchronous reads and writes
  hold the mutex for the transfer; asynchronous writes hold it only while
  submitting work. Worker execution, initialization and release retain
  their existing locking. If absent, normal CCI concurrency is unchanged.

This property is used on both Picasso CCI controllers. Each controller has
its own mutex; requests to different controllers are not serialized.

Example:

&cam_cci0 {
	asus,serialize-i2c;
};

&cam_cci1 {
	asus,serialize-i2c;
};
